messages:
Priya Rao: Noticed a recurring failure mode in the last two postmortems: after rolling deploys we get transient token validation errors and at least one service-account rotation didn’t emit an audit record. Need owners + short deadlines so root causes don't reappear.

Ben Harris: Agree. Quick note on patterns: failures happen ~15-45s after rollout completion, esp when the key-service pod restarts. Logs show signature verification errors and 502s to keystore.

Samira Lopez: Sample error we've been storing in the incident bundle:
```
WARN auth token_verify: signature mismatch, key_id=ks-7f2, upstream=keystore-1/502, trace=tx-77b
```

Ethan G.: Investigated the audit gap: the rotation handler uses async fire-and-forget logging to secure-log. During one rotation the sink endpoint returned 503 and we retried in background but never blocked the rotation commit. We should make that a blocking/confirm step or use a write-with-ack pattern.

Priya Rao: Proposed short-term plan (2-week horizon):
- Owner: Ben Harris  token-cache hardening + post-deploy key handshake smoke (due 2026-05-05)
- Owner: Samira Lopez  rotation write-with-ack + idempotent retry (due 2026-05-08)
- Owner: Ethan G.  instrument keystore HA metrics + synthetic failure tests (due 2026-05-03)
- Owner: Priya Rao  add an "authz anomaly" signal to ops-alerts and a weekly digest (due 2026-05-01)

Ben Harris: Plan: add a short post-deploy handshake where new replicas fetch current JWKs and we validate a signed test token. Will add a CI gating job to run that check after deploy.

Samira Lopez: Plan: change rotation flow to perform secure-log write synchronously with exponential retry up to N attempts; if still failing, roll back rotation and alert on-call. Will include integration test that simulates a sink outage.

Ethan G.: I'll add synthetic keystore failures to staging and measure failover timing. Also will surface keystore client errors to the authz trend dashboard.

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-6010 assigned to Ben Harris, due 2026-05-05

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-6011 assigned to Samira Lopez, due 2026-05-08

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-6012 assigned to Ethan G., due 2026-05-03

Priya Rao: Recommend a one-off smoke window: run the post-deploy handshake across four services tomorrow at 10:00 PT and verify audit writes for two manual rotations. Who can join?

Ben Harris: I can join for the handshake.

Samira Lopez: I can run the rotation test and monitor secure-log.

Ethan G.: Will stand by to induce keystore failover in staging.

Priya Rao: I'll create the calendar invite and update the remediation tracker. Operational rule: if anyone misses their ETA, they must post an update 48h before expiration with scope changes or a reassignment request. Thanks all.

Priya Rao: Also adding follow-up: consider adding an idempotent confirm token issued by keystore that services can validate, to reduce reliance on realtime JWK fetches.
